name: Tinker: Battle Turret X-13 fires its own rounds and closes the gossip window on entry (#11301)
contract: Build: Battle Turret X-13 summons 457772, a vehicle entered through gossip. Live combat logs (2026-08) and the
Descension PTR observations (2026-08-07) show the turret casting Z-9001 Round 503600, Frozen Core Round 503604
and Battery Round 503602 (user-approved 2026-11-14). The seat may only cast spells on the creature's
creature_template_spell list; before the fix it held the Sentry Turret's 706689/706694, so the rounds were refused.
Each round is a trigger-missile spell: Z-9001 lands fire damage 503601, Frozen Core applies its slow 503605 and
Battery applies the stun 503603 to the enemy at the destination. The rounds have a 10-70 yd range, so the enemy
Gossip entry sends the prepared gossip window before the AI seats the player; seating must close it with

steps.label: Let the spawn and level scaling settle
Place a Battle Turret X-13 next to the Tinker
Let the turret script finish its summon setup
Enter the turret through its gossip
The Tinker controls the turret seat
DISCRIMINATING: seating closes the gossip window
Fire Z-9001 Round at the enemy
DISCRIMINATING: Z-9001 Round is on the turret bar and fires
Fire Frozen Core Round at the enemy
DISCRIMINATING: Frozen Core Round fires from the bar
Frozen Core Round slows the enemy
Fire Battery Round at the enemy
DISCRIMINATING: Battery Round fires from the bar
